title: Failure to report abuse or neglect of vulnerable adult -- false reporting -- penalties, MCA TITLE 45 CHAPTER 5 Part 8 45-5-803 Failure to report abuse or neglect of vulnerable adult -- false reporting -- penalties Montana Code Annotated 2025 TITLE 45
subsections: CRIMES CHAPTER 5. OFFENSES AGAINST THE PERSON Part 8. Offenses Against Incapacitated Persons and Vulnerable Adults Failure To Report Abuse Or Neglect Of Vulnerable Adult -- False Reporting -- Penalties 45-5-803. Failure to report abuse or neglect of vulnerable adult -- false reporting -- penalties. A person is guilty of an offense and on conviction is punishable as provided in 46-18-212 if the person purposely or knowingly:
(1) fails to make a report required by 52-3-811;
(2) fails to disclose the contents of a case record or report in violation of 52-3-813;
(3) gives false information to an adult protective services representative or the county attorney with the purpose to implicate another person;
(4) reports to adult protective services or the county attorney an offense or other incident within the person's concern knowing that it did not occur; or

(5) pretends to furnish adult protective services or the county attorney with information relating to an offense or incident when the person knows that the person has no information relating to the offense.
